_comment: Third-party code committed into this repo. There is no package manager here
and that is deliberate — but an unpinned vendored file is a dependency you
cannot reason about: no version, no source, no way to tell a deliberate
upgrade from a corrupted or swapped file. This is the pin.
sim/run-tests.sh verifies each sha256 on every run, so a silent change is
visible instead of arriving as a multiplayer bug nobody can place.
To upgrade: download the new dist, replace the file, update version + sha256
here, and TEST A REAL TWO-CLIENT GAME before pushing — this file is the
entire multiplayer transport and nothing in sim/ exercises it.

upgrade_note: 1.5.5 (2025-06-07) is a single fix — 'inline package version' (#1322), a
packaging change with no functional or security effect on this use. Staying
on 1.5.4 deliberately: swapping the whole transport buys nothing here and
cannot be verified by any suite in sim/. Revisit on a release that matters.
